overview: This file traces Allied disposition of former Japanese naval vessels after World War II. Allocation lists, diplomatic exchanges, and scrapping reports document disputes over 104 remaining warships and vessels used by the Korean Coast Guard. It ends with a 1949 Chinese press allegation about rebuilding Japan’s navy.
interest: Detailed vessel inventories and scrapping tables reveal how Allied diplomacy shaped Japan’s naval disarmament and Korea’s coastal defense.
